title: Jammy Ukrainian Saskatoon Berries Gratin
description: A sweet and tangy gluten-free dessert made with Saskatoon berries, perfect for a family dinner.

ingredients.name: Saskatoon berries
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, thawed if frozen.

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the Saskatoon berries, granulated sugar, and cornstarch. Let it sit for 15 minutes, allowing the berries to release their juice and the mixture to thicken.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch clay pot or baking dish.
Melt the butter and add it to the mixture, stirring to combine. If using almond extract, add it now.
In a separate bowl, mix together the gluten-free flour and salt. Add this mixture to the clay pot and stir until well combined.
Cover the clay pot with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Let the gratin cool for 5 minutes before serving.
